title: C21 PARKER MAGNETIC TRAIL engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

epoch.x-encoding: Integral or real numeric source encoding accepted; exact time unit, epoch and precision must be declared. Large integer timestamps must retain lossless integer/string transport in the ingestion ICD.

magnetic_rtn.x-quality-rule: Coordinate definition and quality flags required.

plasma_velocity.x-quality-rule: Missing cadence remains separate; no forward-fill across gaps.

mass_density.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

event_interval.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

alfvenicity.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
